title: Words and prepositions
descriptionFa: فعل‌ها و صفت‌هایی که همیشه با یه حرف اضافه‌ی مشخص میان.

words.example: I'll wait for you outside the cinema.
words.tipFa: wait for someone، نه wait someone.

words.example: Let me pay for the tickets.
Does this bag belong to you?
words.tipFa: عضویت هم هست: She belongs to a tennis club.

words.example: I often think about my old school friends.
Thank you for the lovely present!
words.tipFa: با اسم دیگه: She thanked her mother for the present.

words.example: I love to look at old family photos.
Can you look after my cat while I'm away?
I look forward to seeing you next week.
words.tipFa: بعدش اسم یا ing: look forward to the holiday / to seeing you.

words.example: I'm good at geography but bad at maths.
words.tipFa: ضدش: bad at. بعدش اسم یا ing: good at playing the piano.

words.example: My son is very interested in science.
My little sister is afraid of dogs.
Her parents are very proud of her.
I'm really happy about your success.
words.tipFa: happy about something، نه happy for something.

words.example: I'm used to getting up early. I always do.
words.tipFa: be used to = به چیزی عادت داری. get used to = داری عادت می‌کنی.
